action.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.type = 'Revenue' THEN g.credit - g.debit ELSE 0 END) AS revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN g.account_id = '5000' THEN g.debit - g.credit ELSE 0 END) AS cogs, 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN a.type = 'Revenue' THEN g.credit - g.debit ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN g.account_id = '5000' THEN g.debit - g.credit ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN a.type = 'Revenue' THEN g.credit - g.debit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gross_margin_pct FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND g.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-03'
